# braidworks runs

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cli_docs.py from `braidworks --help`; do not edit by hand.
     Run `make cli-docs` after changing the command line. -->

List saved runs or inspect a run's status/review choices. For the task this serves, see the [how-to guides](../../how-to/index.md).

```text
usage: braidworks runs [-h] --run-db PATH [--format {human,json}] [run_id]

List saved runs or inspect a run's status/review choices.

positional arguments:
  run_id                show one run (default: list every run).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --run-db PATH         the saved-run store.
  --format {human,json}

examples:
  braidworks runs --run-db runs.sqlite
  braidworks runs p53 --run-db runs.sqlite --format json
```
